A01_TIME_SEMANTICS.modification: Preserve publication_at versus supported_cutoff_at provenance mode; never fabricate exact publication time or intraday precision; time semantic and time/evidence authority are separate.

A03_RUN_RUNATTEMPT_SHARED_REFERENCE_IMPA.modification: Prospective scientific/business lineage binds Logical Run and physical realization binds RunAttempt where material; legacy run_id/capture_run_id semantics remain unchanged and no historical RunAttempt is synthesized.

A05_SCHEMA_FAMILY_VERSIONING.modification: DECLARED_COMPATIBLE_SET must resolve to explicit exact schema versions; Frozen bytes remain immutable; data revision is not schema version.

A06_SOURCE_PROVENANCE.modification: Use stable repository identity not only mutable repository name, verify commit/tree/clean checkout mechanically, bind immutable material inputs and keep execution-source provenance separate from historical-evidence provenance.

A07_NAMESPACE_IDENTITY.modification: Canonical cross-domain tuple is project_namespace/entity_family/local_id; project_namespace is governed logical identity not derived from repo/branch/channel; historical IDs are never rewritten; ambiguity fails closed.

A10_ACTOR_AUTHORITY.modification: Actor and Authority remain separate fields even when the same human/Persona legitimately occupies both roles; authority source and scope must still resolve explicitly.

EXACT_TARGET_DECISION_RECEIPT.modification: Create standalone append-only immutable successor receipt; exact target must resolve to immutable governed identity/version-set, floating branch/latest is invalid; legacy approval fields are not silently rematerialized.

COMPATIBLE_VERSION_SET_RELEASE_MANIFEST.modification: Bind immutable release_set_id/component refs/component_set_sha256/compatibility declaration/Decision Receipt; persisted artifacts bind byte size and persistent locator where applicable; existing shared artifacts are preserved.
